name: sistema
description: Monitoreo del sistema: CPU, RAM, disco, temperatura, uptime
author: Nexo

resumen.exec: echo "=== 🖥 SISTEMA ===" && echo "Uptime: $(uptime -p)" && echo "CPU: $(grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo) cores, $(top -bn1 | grep 'Cpu(s)' | awk '{print $2+$4"% uso"}')" && echo "RAM: $(free -h | awk '/^Mem/ {print $3"/"$2}')" && echo "Disco: $(df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print $3"/"$2}')" && [ -f /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp ] && echo "Temp: $(($(cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp)/1000))°C" || true

cpu.description: Uso de CPU en tiempo real
cpu.exec: echo "Top 5 procesos por CPU:" && ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -6

ram.exec: free -h && echo "" && echo "Top 5 procesos por RAM:" && ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -6

temp.exec: for f in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp; do echo "$(basename $(dirname $f)): $(($(cat $f)/1000))°C"; done 2>/dev/null || echo "No disponible"
